verdicts.otherworld: FAIL — majors: high-frequency speckled cracks over every floor tile, no rest areas (R1); blue circle half over the south cliff/void; bone pillar over a brick wall face; bones poking into the void (R4/R7); triangular wedge pieces and per-tile vertical cuts in the south cliff face (R3); minors: brick wall orange cracks cut at tile top/bottom; stepped wall sides lack end trim
verdicts.pyramid: FAIL — majors: cracked stone floor in the lower rooms high-contrast with a 16px repeat, cut straight against corridor sand with no transition (R1/R5); upper/centre protruding walls and right stepped wall show 4-5 brick rows with no ceiling cap; seed2 bottom ceiling gap squeezed to 1px (R3); minors: three spaced iron grates in the left corridor; scorpion overlaps a pillar; grey-purple rock off-palette
verdicts.ruins: FAIL — majors: moss flagstone repeats the same moss/brown dots at the same spot in every tile, strong 16px grid; sharp 2x2 green patch in the checker marble room (R1/R5); white rubble over the star mosaic and dense rubble in corridors (R4/R7); minors: marble/flagstone doorway cut straight; pillar overlaps a cross slab; dark cult altar off-tone
verdicts.swamp: FAIL — majors: bright teal/white dots on a 16px grid across pond water; broken 1x1 diagonal shoreline tile at a pond neck; lily pads on dry bank (R1/R5/R7); wooden bridge on dry ground; stump without canopy, post and water-dinosaur on bare ground; dark 16px square patches at the forest edge (R1/R4/R7); minors: lamp posts and crystal goblets read as a park
verdicts.tower: PASS — majors: none; minors: asymmetric top trim where round upper and lower rooms meet; missing ceiling trim over the left window; door without lintel; daytime clouds outside with starry windows; bookshelf touching the circle
verdicts.volcano: FAIL — majors: lava lake and river one high-contrast 16px tile with no variants, heavy grid; no inner-corner rim tiles so the grey stone rim breaks and lava is cut at right angles (R1/R5/R7); stepped grey rock walls lack side end tiles (R3); minors: three spaced grates in the left corridor; vertical bridge pieces over N-S lava; grey-purple rock off-palette

fixed.ruins: yes (c62206d2b9): calm limestone everywhere, moss flagstone only in the nave; rubble clusters and the overgrown 2x2 only next to walls; teleport circles no longer stamp over floor decals (mosaic)
fixed.pyramid: partly (c62206d2b9): cracked sandstone only in the pharaoh boss room; walls/caps not touched (wall art, out of floor scope)
fixed.otherworld: no: the speckle is the base floor art itself (already limited to the 6 calmest cells); needs a hand-dot redraw through the gate — not done this round. Circle/bones/cliff = gimmick and wall art, not touched
fixed.swamp: no: water dot pattern, shoreline neck tile and bridge placement are water/gimmick art, out of floor scope
fixed.volcano: no: lava tile and rim corners are lava art (gap lava autotile), out of floor scope; floor itself not flagged
